component-o.description-s: STM32N657xx: high-performance microcontroller featuring an Arm Cortex-M55 32-bit core running up to 800 MHz (up to 1 GHz in overdrive for the ST Neural-ART accelerator), with 4.2-Mbyte contiguous SRAM, 128-Kbyte TCM RAM + 64-Kbyte instruction TCM RAM with ECC, 8-Kbyte backup SRAM, ST Neural-ART neural processing unit (600 Gops), Neo-Chrom 2.5D GPU, hardware JPEG codec, H264 video encoder, ISP with parallel/2-lane CSI-2 camera interfaces, LCD-TFT controller, 2x USB 2.0 HS OTG (one with USB Type-C Power Delivery), 10/100/1000 Ethernet with TSN, 4x I2C Fm+ + 2x I3C, 6x SPI, 2x SAI, 5x USART/5x UART + 1x LPUART, 2x SDMMC, 3x FDCAN, dual 12-bit ADC up to 5 Msps, hardware crypto (AES x2, PKA, HASH, TRNG), and extensive security features (TrustZone, secure boot, SESIP Level 3, Arm PSA certified); packaged in VFBGA142 (8x8 mm, 0.5 mm pitch); operating temperature -40 to 125 degC.

cfgpins-ao.B2c: BOOT0 selects boot source (internal flash/system memory/SRAM per option bytes); tie through a resistor to VSS or VDD per desired default boot mode; do not float

cfgpins-ao.C2c: NRST bidirectional reset with embedded weak pull-up; connect external RC/capacitor per AN recommended NRST protection circuit; do not float

cfgpins-ao.D2c: PWR_ON is a system supply-management input that must be driven according to the power-up sequencing described in the power supply startup section; tie to VDD through the application power sequencer, do not float

cfgpins-ao.A1c: PDR_ON is a power-down-reset control input that must be tied to VDD (or driven by the power sequencer) per the recommended system supply startup sequence; do not float

cfgpins-ao.F3c: VFBSMPS is the feedback pin of the embedded SMPS step-down converter providing VDDCORE; connect to the SMPS LC output filter per AN5967 recommended external component values; do not float

cfgpins-ao.P7c: CSI_REXT sets the CSI PHY internal bias current; connect an external precision resistor to VSSA per datasheet recommended value; do not float

cfgpins-ao.D5c: OTG2_TXRTUNE sets USB2 HS transmit driver impedance; connect external precision resistor to VSS per datasheet; do not float

cfgpins-ao.A6c: OTG1_TXRTUNE sets USB1 HS transmit driver impedance; connect external precision resistor to VSS per datasheet; do not float

cfgpins-ao.C1c: OSC32_IN, 32.768 kHz LSE crystal input; connect crystal and load capacitor to VSS per typical application

cfgpins-ao.B1c: OSC32_OUT, 32.768 kHz LSE crystal output; connect crystal and load capacitor to VSS per typical application

cfgpins-ao.A7c: OSC_IN, HSE crystal (16-48 MHz) input; connect crystal and load capacitor CL1 to VSS per typical application (e.g. 40 MHz crystal)

cfgpins-ao.B7c: OSC_OUT, HSE crystal (16-48 MHz) output; connect crystal and load capacitor CL2 to VSS per typical application
